translation_fidelity: Current and diplomatic translations must retain the original work. follow_on.limits: Do not claim novelty without evidence or turn a possibility into a proved result. The later synthesis does not replace or delay core correction integration, received Pursuing Stacks work, or gap-first EGA.

records.rationale: The sum notation is interpreted via the canonical summand inclusions. If i_M:M→M⊕N and i_N:N→M⊕N, the second map sends (i_M(x)+i_N(y),z) to j_M(x⊗z)+j_N(y⊗z), where j_M and j_N are the target inclusions. It is bilinear, so induces F:(M⊕N)⊗P→(M⊗P)⊕(N⊗P). Its inverse G is induced on the two summands by x⊗z↦i_M(x)⊗z and y⊗z↦i_N(y)⊗z. On each elementary tensor in either summand, FG is the identity. On (i_M(x)+i_N(y))⊗z, GF equals i_M(x)⊗z+i_N(y)⊗z, which is the original element by bilinearity. These elements generate, so both composites are identities.

records.rationale: Prove the exact field-generator criterion and the finite-field bound behind the composition counterexample.
records.adverse_evidence: A finite etale algebra is standard etale exactly when it is monogenic. Over F_q a product with r_d copies of F_(q^d) is monogenic iff r_d does not exceed the number of monic irreducibles of degree d. The full Mobius formula is proved. Two F_4 factors already give a composition counterexample. Over infinite fields finitely many shifts avoid all cross-factor conjugate collisions, so every etale algebra is standard.
proved_further_consequences: For finite etale algebras over a field, standard etale is equivalent to one algebra generator. Over F_q the exact multiplicity thresholds are r_d <= (1/d) sum_(e divides d) mu(e) q^(d/e). The original F_4^4 example is valid, and F_4^2 already works. Over an infinite field every etale algebra, and thus every composition of standard etale maps starting at that field, is standard etale.
